exam.title: AWS Certified Security - Specialty
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal certification prerequisite; the detailed AWS guide targets the equivalent of 3–5 years securing cloud solutions, while the live page describes five years of IT-security experience and two or more years securing AWS workloads. Practice detection/log pipelines, incident response, infrastructure and GenAI protections, IAM/KMS evaluation, data/key/secret/backup controls, multi-account governance, secure deployment, evidence collection and troubleshooting.

review.notes: The current six-domain SCS-C03 guide was reconciled with every detailed domain page, the live 170-minute/65-question/USD-300 certification page, non-exhaustive service list, and AWS's C02-to-C03 comparison. Three scenarios, eight safe labs and 42 original checks cover protected telemetry, evidence-preserving response, edge/workload/GenAI/network controls, IAM/KMS policy evaluation, encryption/key/secret/backup controls, multi-account governance, secure deployment and compliance evidence. All 18 URLs are cataloged: 16 were reachable and two Udemy routes were automation-blocked; none was missing or broken. Current metadata and the differing official experience descriptions are labeled, older C02 material has an explicit gap checklist, and no recalled questions are used.
